text:
maria: Quick roundup from the DB fail PM follow-ups. Need to lock owners, due dates, and Jira links. Keep replies short so I can paste into the doc.

owen: I will take the eviction TTL correctness patch and the unit tests. R=owen, A=maria, C=kevin, I=lenora. ETA: Thu EOD.

kevin: I'll own the perf regression investigation and the perf harness. Will add a tiny benchmark suite to CI. ETA: Fri.

lenora: I'll handle the rollout canary plan + update the postmortem owners table. Also add rollback thresholds. ETA: Monday.

owen: creating ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-5010 (TTL+tests). Moving to In Progress when branch is up.

kevin: ticket for perf -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-5011. Adding a 99p latency check and alert threshold.

lenora: added RDW-5012 for canary + runbook updates. Linking all tickets in the doc now. Set due date 2026-04-09.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-5010 is due in 2 days.

maria: Please include acceptance criteria inline here before you close tickets. Minimal AC: 1) TTL fix + unit tests, 2) perf 99p within 2% of baseline or rollback in place, 3) 24h canary with automated rollback signal, 4) postmortem doc updated with RACI and tickets.

owen: adding AC to RDW-5010 and pushing a PR. PR checklist snippet I'm adding to PR description:

```
- [ ] TTL patch merged
- [ ] unit tests passing
- [ ] perf harness attached
- [ ] canary config + rollback tested
- [ ] postmortem updated with tickets
```

kevin: Suggest we also add a small mitigation runbook step that oncall can trigger for fast rollback. I'll draft RDW-5013.

lenora: good idea. kevin, please create RDW-5013 and set owner to you.

kevin: created RDW-5013 (runbook + rollback script). ETA: end of day.

maria: Great. Last administrative: add the Jira links to the postmortem doc and update the "Owners" table with RACI and an ISO due date. I'll verify in planning and close the loop.

owen: done, updated doc and RACI table. tagging @kevin for perf review. :thumbsup:

lenora: all tickets linked. setting final review on 2026-04-09.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-5010 (owen) and RDW-5013 (kevin) marked high priority by maria.

maria: Thanks everyone 12 I'll paste this thread into the PM actions section and follow up if anything slips. Close thread after QA verifies AC.
